title: Research: flag-9 I−G/2 end-cut side correction attains +2 rank mass (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. Open [#3614](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3614) proved a non-private +2 lower bound for flag 9's primary entry on the published word (feeder `X58:333` @ leave 745; 25/25 zero-mass) but constructed no attaining correction word. This package supplies that bill.

On the published native word, flag 9's `I − G/2` entry `(23,4)` (`G[23,4]=−1` ⇒ add `+1/2·X4` into `Y23`) at end-cut 3489:

| Word | Δ transports | Δ ADDs | Δ rank mass | Profile Δ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| **T** (target lift `A3→FULL`, ADD, descend) | +1 | +1 | **+2** | `H1 − H5 + H6` |
| **S** (source detour `FULL→F23→FULL`) | +2 | +1 | **+2** | `2H1` |
| **P** (one private-copy lifetime; admissibility open) | +1 | +1 | **+1** | `H1` |
| **T48** (whole row 23 on T's lift) | +1 | +48 | **+2** | (row becomes identity) |

Native `check_native.validate()` passes each coefficient-0 word (three new recipes `A3→FULL` + `FULL↔F23`). Real words fail only at `Y23`'s endpoint; only `Y23` changes. Feeder/obstruction recomputed: `X58:333` @ 745 blocks 25/25 zero-mass classes (and 7/7 early private deliveries), matching #3614. Strict non-private minimum **exactly +2** (attained). No co-hosted repair (that path remains deferred).

**Scoped bill. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/p104-flag9-side-correction-bill/`
- Tip: `0c4b73507ba7ed7b992e47b17f2cbcb6e362466b`
- Content tip: `f2c20bc4d82558bb4ff280a49814e70778816e96`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — flag-9 entry only, published end-cut

Closest priors: [#3614](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3614) (feeder/floor leave-alone; obstruction recomputed, not imported — this closes its attaining-word OQ2), [#3601](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3601) (flag-43 format prior; co-hosted cut — distinct obligation), [#3610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3610) (flag-1 format prior), [#3443](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3443) (chronology cited only). Soft-overlap with #3601 is template-level (verify≈0.69, independent≈0.83, test≈0.93); scientific novelty is the flag-9 attaining end-cut words + P route on the published chronology, not a reprint of #3601's co-hosted bill or of #3614's lower-bound census. **P (+1)** uses the inherited private-copy discard contract; admissibility is open — strict non-private minimum remains +2. Does not reopen deferred flag-9 head-step repair; no co-host discount claimed. Not a supplier.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-flag9-side-correction-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag9-side-correction-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag9-side-correction-bill/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag9-side-correction-bill/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag9-side-correction-bill
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_FLAG9_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL flag=9 entry=(23,4) gram=-1 coefficient=+1/2 zero_mass_placements=0/25 forcing=X58(333)@leave745 strict_min_added_rank=2 … native_validate=4/4 published_end_cut no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG9_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL_INDEPENDENT … forcing_head=333(X58)@leave745 T=+2rank S=+2rank P=+1rank T48=+2rank … new_recipes=3 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG9_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL_TESTS cases=14 clean_read_only=1 scanners=2
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-flag9-side-correction-bill outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions

1. Is private-copy P admissible, or must correction lifetimes be uncomputed?
2. If a co-hosted flag-9 repair later lands, does +2 discount?
3. Full-row (~48) forcing census on Y7/Y23/Y59 — #3614 OQ1.
